answer: Proof of Stake serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism where validator influence scales linearly with capital lock-up rather than node count. By anchoring network participation in economic shale, the system renders identity duplication futile, as an attacker cannot simply whisper new aliases into existence to garner weight. This protocol forces an ivory tower of prohibitive costs on sybils, ensuring that any attempt to dilute consensus requires acquiring the majority of the total staked assets.
